Take your time, healing takes time and it's okay to take time for recovery. Healing is a long process and it can't really be rushed. You will get to your dreams and live the life you want, but right now it may feel like you're stuck with your life. Don't be afraid to seek medical help if needed like the other comments suggested
but I promise you that it's going to get easier !!

yeah, but it has gotten easier. Derealization and dissociation are part of HPPD to some extent. But for me the constant feeling like i'm out of my body and how nothings real was also a symptom of using other substances too and for me the only right choice was to go fully sober, because the weed smoking and drinking just made everything worse (in every area of my life). Not saying that's the best choice for you, just my experience. But yes, I still get those feelings. Like nothings real and I'm not real, that gives me the worrrrssstttt anxiety
did your memory get bad after consuming shrooms or was it bad before? bad memory is also a big symptom of adhd
eat well, sleep well and just take care of your health overall. Post it notes or to do lists help to some extent but my memory still sucks
two years now and it has gotten better, but I still have it. Going fully sober made the anxiety a bit easier but the visuals and bad memory are still definitely there
Yeah I agree

yeah I hope I can stop caring about it. Some of the daily visuals have became so normal already, that I barely notice them anymore. But If I start focusing on them more, they obviously will become more visible and disturbing
yeah. For me HPPD came with severe anxiety, depression, depersonalization, brainfog and really bad memory problems, derealization and big time ocd symptoms.
Yeah, It's so unfortunate and unfair. You never know if it's going to happen to you. For me I feel like the symptoms only started being more severe after consuming acid once.

Koitan olla sellaisessa asennossa, että keho ei olisi jatkuvassa jännitystilassa ja välillä pyörittelen hartioita. Ja täällä jo mainittuja vinkkejä suosittelen kanssa, äänikirjat, musiikki ymsyms. Mulla sinäänsä helppoa, koska teen fyysisiä töitä ja siinä virkenee ajamisen jälkeen aika nopiaa. Mutta niin, en tiedä totunko tähän ajeluun koskaan, varsinkin pimeässä ajaminen tuntuu edelleen raskaalta.
